flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds show a sizable rise in the Democrats' chances of winning control of the Senate. In [[Kansas]], the Democrat Adam Hamilton gained sharply and the market now sees a predicted flip. In [[Iowa]], the Republican Ashley Hinson saw a sharp drop in their chances, and in [[Michigan]], the Democrat Abdul El-Sayed gained ground.
summaries.governor: In [[Kansas]], a predicted flip, the Republican Ty Masterson saw a sizable drop in chances. Republican incumbents slipped by a sizable amount in [[Texas]] and [[Vermont]] as well, with Greg Abbott and Phil Scott each seeing their odds fall. Kelly Ayotte in New Hampshire also lost ground, according to the Polymarket odds.
summaries.house: The biggest move came in [[NY-17 (Spring Valley & Ossining)]], where the Democrat Cait Conley saw a sharp drop in their chances, and the market lists the seat as a predicted flip. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott gained ground sharply. Over in [[AR-02 (Little Rock & Conway)]], the Republican French Hill slipped by a sizable amount in Polymarket odds.
